title: spermacoce lagurus
intro: Spermacoce lagurus, commonly known as Woodruff, is a perennial herb that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in reducing inflammation and protecting the body from oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce lagurus include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and diuretic, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Spermacoce lagurus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
